allow: Shell(echo "===cmd version==="; cmd --version 2>&1 | head -2; echo "===which cmd==="; which -a cmd; echo "===settings.json hooks==="; python3 -c "import json;d=json.load(open('$HOME/.commandcode/settings.json'));print(list(d.get('hooks',{}).keys()))" 2>&1; echo "===plugin manifest startup/hooks==="; grep -n -i "startup\|hooks\|\[\[panes\]\]\|\[\[actions\]\]" ~/.config/herdr/plugins/github/commandcode.integration-*/herdr-plugin.toml; echo "===herdr plugin list==="; herdr plugin list 2>&1 | head -5)

Shell(python3 - <<'PY' import json, os p = os.path.expanduser("~/.commandcode/settings.json") d = json.load(open(p)) hooks = d.get("hooks", {}) removed = hooks.pop("SessionStart", None) json.dump(d, open(p, "w"), indent=2) open(p, "a").write("\n") print("removed SessionStart entries:", len(removed or [])) print("remaining hooks:", list(hooks.keys())) PY cat > ~/.config/herdr/config.toml <<'EOF' onboarding = false [theme] name = "dracula" auto_switch = false [ui] status_indicators = "symbols" [ui.sound] enabled = true [ui.toast] delivery = "system" # Command Code agent (commandcode.integration plugin). # Herdr >= 0.9.1 has no `plugin_pane` keybind type, so the plugin pane is opened # through the CLI (shell runs detached; the server creates the real PTY pane). # SessionStart is intentionally NOT installed in ~/.commandcode/settings.json. [[keys.command]] key = "prefix+c" type = "shell" command = '"${HERDR_BIN_PATH:-herdr}" plugin pane open --plugin commandcode.integration --entrypoint task --focus' description = "Command Code: new task" EOF echo "===CHECK==="; herdr config check 2>&1 | head; echo "===RELOAD==="; herdr server reload-config 2>&1 | head)

Shell(which roamgate; echo "---"; roamgate --help 2>&1 | head -60; echo "=== HERDR ==="; herdr --help 2>&1 | head -40; echo "=== CONFIG DIR ==="; ls -la ~/.config/herdr 2>&1; echo "=== HERDR CONFIG FILES ==="; find ~/.config/herdr -maxdepth 2 -type f 2>&1)

Shell(echo "=== systemd ==="; (systemctl --user is-system-running 2>&1; systemctl --user status --no-pager 2>&1 | head -5) ; echo "=== linger ==="; loginctl show-user "$USER" 2>&1 | grep -i linger || echo "loginctl no disponible"; echo "=== WSL ==="; (grep -qi microsoft /proc/version && echo "WSL: $(cat /proc/version)" || echo "no WSL"); echo "=== IP ==="; hostname -I 2>/dev/null; echo "=== herdr server ==="; herdr status 2>&1 | head -20)

Shell(ls:*)

Shell(cd ~ && HOST=127.0.0.1 roamgate service install 2>&1 | tail -30; echo "=== roamgate.env ==="; cat ~/.config/roamgate/roamgate.env 2>&1; echo "=== unit ==="; cat ~/.config/systemd/user/roamgate.service 2>&1)

Shell(sudo -n loginctl enable-linger "$USER" 2>&1 && echo "linger habilitado" || echo "SUDO_NO_DISPONIBLE"; echo "=== estado ==="; loginctl show-user "$USER" -p Linger 2>&1; echo "=== service status ==="; roamgate service status 2>&1 | head -12)

Shell(echo "=== wsl.conf ==="; cat /etc/wsl.conf 2>&1; echo "=== resolv/route ==="; ip route 2>/dev/null | head; echo "=== tailscale? ==="; (which tailscale && tailscale status 2>&1 | head -5) || echo "tailscale NO instalado"; echo "=== powershell reachable? ==="; (which powershell.exe && echo "powershell.exe OK") || echo "sin powershell.exe"; echo "=== windows host ==="; ip route | awk '/default/{print $3}')

Shell(echo "=== winget ==="; powershell.exe -NoProfile -Command "if (Get-Command winget.exe -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { (winget.exe --version) } else { 'NO_WINGET' }" 2>&1 | tr -d '\r'; echo "=== admin? ==="; powershell.exe -NoProfile -Command "([Security.Principal.WindowsPrincipal][Security.Principal.WindowsIdentity]::GetCurrent()).IsInRole([Security.Principal.WindowsBuiltInRole]::Administrator)" 2>&1 | tr -d '\r'; echo "=== tun en WSL ==="; ls -l /dev/net/tun 2>&1; echo "=== WSL version ==="; (wsl.exe --version 2>/dev/null | tr -d '\0\r' | head -8) || echo "wsl.exe no alcanzable")

Shell(powershell.exe -NoProfile -Command "try { \$r = Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 10 'http://desktop-pvatqm2.taildd8a60.ts.net/'; 'Status: ' + \$r.StatusCode; 'Length: ' + \$r.Content.Length; (\$r.Content -split \"\`n\" | Select-String -Pattern '<title>|roamgate|Herdr' | Select-Object -First 3) } catch { 'ERROR: ' + \$_.Exception.Message }" 2>&1 | tr -d '\r' | head -12)

Shell(echo "=== herdr server --help ==="; herdr server --help 2>&1 | head -30; echo; echo "=== arbol de procesos ==="; ps -o pid,ppid,pgid,lstart,cmd -p 5146,5148 2>&1; echo "=== quien es el padre ==="; ppid=$(ps -o ppid= -p 5146 2>/dev/null | tr -d ' '); echo "ppid de 5146 = $ppid"; [ -n "$ppid" ] && ps -o pid,ppid,cmd -p "$ppid" 2>&1; echo "=== herdr client log (cola) ==="; tail -5 ~/.config/herdr/herdr-client.log 2>&1)
